title: Review CI verdict
description: Written by both the code-review and test-review jobs. The pass/fail decision is derived from findings[].severity by the workflow, never supplied by the model.

work_package_id.description: OpenProject work package the PR is linked to, if any.

summary.description: Two or three sentences a human can read without opening the findings.

severity.description: Final tier, after the self-challenge pass.

initial_severity.description: Tier first assigned, before the self-challenge pass. Differs from severity when the finding was re-graded.

title.description: One line, shown in the summary table.

claim.description: What is wrong and what merging it as-is would cause.

evidence.description: What in the code supports the claim: the triggering input or state, the missing test, the quoted line.

file.description: Repo-relative path, or null for a finding with no single location (e.g. an acceptance criterion with no test anywhere).

criterion.description: test-review only: the acceptance criterion this finding concerns, quoted from the work package.
